hubTrigger.claim: China planned very large long-term support for domestic semiconductor production, with homegrown chips still below 10% of local demand.

candidate.name: 七星电子

evidence.claim: Q1 revenue RMB117.3m, -28.27% YoY; attributable profit +17.66% but ex-item profit was a RMB7.17m loss.
Company was a direct domestic semiconductor-equipment name, but contemporaneous earnings conversion was weak.

candidate.rationale: The policy creates a large long-horizon opportunity pool, but contemporaneous company revenue and core earnings do not show a fresh conversion. Later equipment sales/validation cannot be used at the Q2 cutoff.
